correctness.rationale: Every selected rook cell represents one edge of K_{m,n}; its induced degree is its row degree plus column degree minus 2. Splitting by the uniquely determined parities yields the two independent allowed matrix blocks. Fourier signs correctly filter every row and column parity even in zero-size dimensions. For two rows, doubled columns exclude singles; disjoint two-clique cases give the elementary polynomials and exact support. Independent adjacency enumeration checked 1,412,734 subsets, plus 64 Fourier blocks and 60 additional support orders. Unbounded quantifiers are discharged by the combinatorial proof, not numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The natural graph family includes every line graph of a complete bipartite graph. The theorem supplies the entire cardinality distribution for induced subgraphs of uniform degree parity rather than only the largest possible order. In complete prisms the sharp modulus-four obstruction, exact binomial multiplicities and arbitrarily many missing even cardinalities give a motivated all-order structural phenomenon that is not a direct consequence of general complexity results.
